name: Sustenance
body:
Discipline psychometabolism; Level dread 2, gifted blade 2, marksman 2, psion/wilder 2, psychic warrior 2, tactician 2, vitalist 2

MANIFESTING

Display Material
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration Instantaneous
Power Points 3

DESCRIPTION

You can go without food and water for one day. Each time you manifest this power, your body manufactures sufficient solid and liquid nourishment to satisfy your needs for that time.
